name: Zeitview
all_locations: Los Angeles, CA, USA; Santa Monica, CA, USA; Remote
long_description: At Zeitview, our goal is to accelerate the transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure. We do this by combining advanced inspection software with the ability to capture visual data in more than 60 countries. This allows us to deliver safer, faster, lower-cost inspections of energy and infrastructure assets with a high degree of accuracy and repeatability. We use artificial intelligence and machine learning to ingest and analyze vast amounts of visual data to provide objective insights that our customers can act on immediately.
one_liner: Inspection software for renewable energy & sustainable infrastructure
